baseline_models.mechanism: The clause turns proximity into a calibrated upper bound: a bow-based span states the maximum interval, while أَدْنَى keeps a smaller interval live.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predication makes the measured proximity an attained state.
The bow-span branch supplies the concrete unit and its bounded extent.
Measuring one thing by another makes the bow a comparator rather than decoration.
Nearness and approximation contract the stated bound without fixing an exact minimum.

changed_reading.before: The clause simply says that the encounter was very close.
changed_reading.after: The clause reports closeness as an attained, measured maximum of two bow-spans, possibly less.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dual قَوْسَيْنِ joined to قَابَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The two bows can function as aligned comparators: their matched form makes proximity a relation of commensurability and pacing, not merely a length laid on empty space.

activation_trace.role: The bow-span gives the alignment a finite shared scale.
Keeping pace and following a model activates matched movement between the two terms.
The race line for aligning horses supplies a common line on which separation becomes comparable.
Mutual approach converts alignment into convergent relation.

changed_reading.before: Two bows are inert units laid end to end.
changed_reading.after: The dual bows also image two terms brought onto one scale and into close alignment.

baseline_models.mechanism: Curvature bends an outer span inward; the doubled bow image can therefore render closeness as converging arcs whose geometry closes toward a center.

activation_trace.role: Bow-like curvature supplies the inward-bending geometry.
The upper part bending toward the middle gives curvature a direction of approach.
The independent coming-near branch keeps the geometric activation tied to proximity.

changed_reading.before: The interval is imagined only as a straight line.
changed_reading.after: The interval may also be imagined as two curved trajectories folding toward convergence.

baseline_models.mechanism: The rare material branches of ق و ب let the measured arc become a marked hollow or lip, while ك و ن and the fixed-residence branch make the clause a station at that boundary.

activation_trace.role: Place and position turn the attained state into a localized station.
Rounded hollowing and a ground mark supply a material boundary with an edge.
Fixed residence changes a passing interval into a momentarily stable station.
The bow curve shapes the hollow or lip without replacing the lexical bow.
Nearness places the encounter at the boundary rather than beyond it.

changed_reading.before: The verse gives only an abstract distance.
changed_reading.after: The distance may also localize a stable, curved threshold at which approach comes to rest.

context_deltas.mechanism: Falling, approach from above, a repeated descent, and an endpoint convert the focus measure from a static gap into the residual interval of a downward trajectory arriving at its limit.

activation_trace.role: The bow-length measure quantifies what remains of the trajectory.
Approximation supplies the contracting terminal interval.
Falling into a depth establishes a downward vector at the surah's opening.
The explicit approach immediately before the focus starts the final contraction.
Descending from above gives the approach a vertical direction.
A single descent, then another, confirms descent as a repeatable event geometry.
The endpoint branch makes the measured proximity terminal rather than indefinite.

structural_cues: 53:7-9 moves from the upper horizon through approach and descent into a measured near-state.
53:13-14 repeats descent and locates it at an endpoint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fall, height, approach, descent, and endpoint; I connect them as one contracting trajectory whose remainder is measured. A static face-to-face interval remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The two-bow interval is a static snapshot with no directional history.
changed_reading.after: It is the terminal remainder of a descent from height, the point at which approach nearly exhausts distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Teaching and concealed, rapid impartation make calibrated nearness operational: the narrow interval is where disclosure crosses into reception.

activation_trace.role: The bow-span gives the transmission interface a bounded scale.
Approach narrows the separation across which impartation occurs.
Disclosure to a knower identifies knowledge transfer as the surrounding function.
Secret impartation makes the near-state a channel for concealed knowledge.
Speed makes the interface event-like rather than a prolonged residence.

structural_cues: 53:4-5 frames the scene as revelation and teaching before the approach.
53:10 follows the measured proximity immediately with revelation to the servant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies teaching, nearness, and immediately subsequent hidden impartation; I infer that proximity enables or marks the transfer. Mere narrative succession, without causal force, remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The clause answers only how close the encounter became.
changed_reading.after: The clause also marks the calibrated interface at which hidden knowledge is transmitted.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated seeing, negated visual deviation and limit-crossing, and the later contrast between conjecture and truth make أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ a disciplined observational bound rather than careless uncertainty.

activation_trace.role: Comparison and measurement supply an explicit observational scale.
Approximation lets the report state a maximum while preserving a closer possibility.
Eye and insight anchor the measure in witnessed perception.
Negated visual drift rules out a wandering estimate.
Direct eyesight identifies the faculty whose range is being disciplined.
Negated crossing of a limit gives the report a bounded evidentiary posture.
Doubt and imagining provide the rejected alternative to measured witness.
Stable correspondence to reality supplies the standard against conjecture.
Reaching a limit turns knowledge itself into something with a bounded extent.

structural_cues: 53:11-18 repeatedly asserts seeing while negating falsehood, drift, and excess.
53:23-30 contrasts unsupported naming and conjecture with guidance, truth, and the reach of knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured comparison, reliable sight, rejected drift, and a conjecture-truth contrast; I infer that the alternative in the focus marks precision within an upper bound. It may instead be rhetorical intensification with no observational-tolerance function.

changed_reading.before: Or nearer sounds like hesitation about the distance.
changed_reading.after: Or nearer is a controlled upper-bound report: perception does not claim a larger gap than it can warrant.

context_deltas.mechanism: A place bearing the trace of descent, repeated presence at an endpoint, and covering strengthen the focus's rare hollow, place, and fixed-residence branches into a bounded station rather than a passing gap.

activation_trace.role: Place and position localize the attained proximity.
A rounded hollow and ground mark provide a material trace with a boundary.
Fixed residence makes the boundary a station at which movement pauses.
A place where descent leaves a visible trace activates the marked-ground reading.
Near presence establishes occupancy at the named boundary.
The terminal limit closes the station on one side.
A covering over the place gives the boundary an enclosing surface.

structural_cues: 53:13-16 repeats descent, at-presence, endpoint, and covering around a named place.
The focus itself predicates a state rather than supplying another finite motion verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a descent-trace place, presence, endpoint, and covering; I let those images activate the focus root's hollow and fixed-station branches. The safer alternative is that these later locations do not retroactively materialize the bow measure.

changed_reading.before: The encounter merely passes through a quantified interval.
changed_reading.after: The measured interval can also be a marked liminal station, enclosed and held at an endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: Division, binding authority, joining one party to another, and permission activate the dual bows as two aligned relational terms: nearness does not erase distinction or confer access by itself.

activation_trace.role: The common race line supplies alignment without collapsing the two aligned terms.
Measurement keeps the relation calibrated rather than merely affective.
Apportioning distinct shares foregrounds how a dyad can be related yet asymmetrical.
Compelling warrant makes relation depend on authority rather than invented naming.
An intercessor joining another supplies the social mechanism of a paired relation.
Permission governs whether relational nearness becomes effective access.

structural_cues: 53:21-23 exposes an unjust allocation and unsupported naming.
53:26 retains paired intercession but subordinates its efficacy to permission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a grammatical dual, allocation, authority, joining, and permission; I infer that the two bows may image aligned relational terms whose access is governed. They may remain only metrological units with no social mapping.

changed_reading.before: Two bows denote only a neutral quantity of space.
changed_reading.after: They can also stage two distinct but aligned parties, with closeness real yet access still authorized rather than automatic.

context_deltas.mechanism: Purposeful movement, arrival at an appointed meeting, and the final endpoint reactivate the bow's alignment line: the focus becomes a telic geometry in which movement resolves into terminal nearness.

activation_trace.role: The race alignment line gives directed movement a common terminus.
Approach describes the final contraction toward that terminus.
Purposeful movement toward a sought object supplies the directed course.
Arrival at an appointment turns motion into completed meeting.
The ultimate endpoint makes convergence teleological.

structural_cues: 53:39-42 sequences striving, its being seen, full return, and the endpoint toward the Lord.
This trajectory runs toward a terminus, complementing the earlier descent from above.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purposeful movement, arrival, and endpoint; I map them onto the focus's alignment and approach branches as a goal-directed convergence. The focus may describe only the earlier descending participant rather than this broader telic pattern.

changed_reading.before: The focus preserves only the endpoint of one descending motion.
changed_reading.after: It can also model any directed course resolving at its true terminus, so descent and striving remain opposite but coexisting trajectories.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence of paired opposites and explicit creation of a pair makes the grammatical dual in قَوْسَيْنِ salient as a designed dyadic form: two distinct curves become mutually defining as they converge.

activation_trace.role: Two bow-like curves supply a visibly paired form.
Mutual measurement lets each member define the relation to the other.
Proportioning and measuring make the dyad an ordered form rather than accidental doubling.
A counterpart joined to its counterpart activates the relational force of the dual.

structural_cues: 53:43-45 presents laughter and weeping, death and life, then the male and female pair under one repeated agent.
The dual form in 53:9 can be heard retroactively within this patterned pairing without identifying its referents with any later pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated antithetical pairs, explicit pair-creation, and a dual bow image; I infer a formal analogy of coordinated distinction. I do not infer that the two bows lexically denote male and female or any single later pair.

changed_reading.before: The number two is incidental to the chosen unit.
changed_reading.after: The dual itself becomes meaningful: nearness is figured by two distinct, proportioned counterparts converging without fusion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The approaching event, haste, nearness short of a goal, and removal of covering convert the focus's spatial calibration into a temporal pattern of imminence and disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predication allows the measured near-state to serve as an event pattern.
Nearness supplies the spatial template that imminence reuses.
Drawing near transfers the focus's contraction from space to time.
Haste makes the remaining interval urgent rather than merely small.
Nearness that remains short of the goal preserves a final unreached threshold.
Lifting a cover makes arrival coincide with disclosure.

structural_cues: 53:57 repeats the approach root twice in a compact announcement of the approaching event.
53:58 places the event near a final threshold whose disclosure belongs to God alone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spatial nearness in the focus and temporal approach, urgency, a remaining threshold, and unveiling near the end; I infer that the later event reactivates the focus geometry as imminence. The recurrence may be thematic echo rather than a direct semantic revision.

changed_reading.before: The two-bow measure belongs only to one past spatial encounter.
changed_reading.after: It also becomes a template for an approaching event whose remaining time is compressed to the verge of disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing contrast between raised-head heedlessness and bowed prostration activates the focus's curvature, inward bending, and humbling branches: relational nearness can be bodily enacted by lowering and bending.

activation_trace.role: The humbling branch gives the attained state a posture of submission.
Bow-like curvature supplies the body's arched geometry.
The upper body bending toward its middle makes lowering a mode of approach.
Raised head and standing provide the opposed posture from which the body must turn.
Bowing the head realizes curvature as commanded movement.
Lowering and humility give the curved motion its relational force.

structural_cues: 53:61-62 pivots directly from an elevated or heedless posture to prostration and worship.
The focus roots independently contain curvature, upper-body bending, and humbling branches.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed postures at the close and focus branches of curvature, inward bending, and submission; I connect bodily lowering with enacted nearness. This is a formal echo, not a claim that قَوْسَيْنِ lexically means prostration.

changed_reading.before: The bow geometry remains an external description of distance.
changed_reading.after: The geometry can become a demanded bodily response: bend from raised distance into humble nearness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rare egg-breaking branch of ق و ب where the syntax plainly foregrounds a bow measure. It remains anchored in قَابَ, the enclosing bow curve, and أَدْنَىٰ; downstream prose should present it only as a liminal material analogy, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَابَ beside the curved قَوْسَيْنِ and approaching أَدْنَىٰ

activation_trace.role: A chick breaking from its egg supplies an irreversible crossing from enclosure into emergence.
Bow curvature supplies the enclosing arc or shell-like boundary.
Approach places the event at the verge of crossing.

changed_reading.before: Nearness only reduces a reversible spatial gap.
changed_reading.after: Nearness can mark the instant before an irreversible emergence across a curved boundary.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the one-seen-as-two branch belongs to the later intercession root, not to the surface meaning of قَوْسَيْنِ. It remains anchored in the focus dual and the surah's repeated visual register; downstream prose should qualify it as a perceptual-doubling activation, not assert that only one bow existed.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The dual قَوْسَيْنِ within a repeatedly witnessed scene

activation_trace.role: Measurement keeps the doubled appearance tied to one comparable span.
Eye and insight establish the scene's perceptual register.
Seeing one as two activates the possibility that duality is an effect of relational perception.

changed_reading.before: Two bows must be two wholly independent measuring objects.
changed_reading.after: The dual may carry a faint activation of one relational span appearing doubled from its two sides.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain material echo is surprising because it links the focus's rare ground-hollow branch to the later overturned, cast-down, covered city. It remains anchored in قَابَ and bow curvature, but downstream prose should call it an activated imprint image rather than make the focus predict that catastrophe.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The rounded-mark branch of قَابَ shaped by قَوْسَيْنِ

activation_trace.role: Rounded hollowing and a ground mark supply the possible material imprint.
Curvature gives the imprint an arc-like shape.
Overturning and redirecting matter supply the reversal that makes an imprint.
Casting down into depth provides the impact direction.
Covering seals or obscures the resulting ground trace.

changed_reading.before: The bow measure leaves no material trace.
changed_reading.after: A remote material activation lets the curved near-point resemble the hollow imprint where a descending reversal lands and is covered.

strongest_changes: The static span became the terminal remainder of a descent from the upper horizon.
The measured near-state became an operational interface for revelation and a disciplined upper-bound report rather than uncertainty.
Later endpoint and imminence language let the same geometry coexist as spatial station, telic convergence, and compressed time.
The dual bows remained a measure while also activating aligned parties, designed counterparts, and embodied curvature.
summary.what_was_special: The once-only focus roots make the line unusually generative: the ordinary bow-span reading stays strong, while the same inventories preserve alignment, curvature, hollowing, fixed station, rupture, and submission. Context does not select one winner; it turns those branches into several traceable spatial, epistemic, social, temporal, and bodily models.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not settle which participants or viewpoint define the measured interval.
أَوْ may mark an upper bound, rhetorical intensification, or both.
The dual may remain purely metrological even where pairing and alignment are strongly activated.
The hollow, emergence, doubling, catastrophe-imprint, and prostration models are branch-distant analogies and should not displace the bow-span reading.
